item.title: In partnership with Julianne Hough and Derek Hough, Ovation by DanceOne is set to deliver cutting-edge training and high-energy competition led by today’s most sought-after dancers and choreographers. The brand-new, multi-genre convention and competition fuses the innovation of the convention world and styles like Contemporary and Jazz with the fire and flair of international Latin ballroom, creating a truly unparalleled experience with education, inspiration, and elevation front and center at every turn.
